newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to lease electric car in U.S. in May.
newsitem.headline: Honda to lease electric car in U.S. in May.

text.p: Honda Motor Co. Ltd said Wednesday it will launch a battery-powered electric vehicle for leasing in the United States in May.

The car, called EV Plus, is powered by nickel-metal hydride batteries. The car has a maximum driving range of 130 miles when the batteries are fully charged and a top speed of 80 mph, a company spokesman said.
The leasing fee in the United States will be $499 per month.
The company also plans to introduce the EV Plus in Japan this fall, the spokesman said. It aims to lease a total of 300 cars in Japan by 2000.
The spokesman said Honda has not yet decided whether to offer the car for sale rather than lease.
